content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: embeddings-prod latency spike detected. 90th percentile embedding latency > 4s for the last 2m. Auto-page threshold breached. source=canary-deploy/v2-embed-quant

pd-bot: PagerDuty incident #INC12345 created and paged: embeddings-prod-high-latency. Escalation: maria (oncall) -> alex (sre).

maria (oncall): Acked. Looking now. Any recent deploys?

sam (eng): Yes — rolled out v2-embed-quant to 15% canary at 13:17 UTC. No full rollout yet. I saw a mild bump in perf locally with quantization changes but not this level.

alex (sre): Adding context: KV cache hit rate dropped ~30% at the same time as latency spike. Could be model changed input size or batching behavior.

maria (oncall): Confirming spike across 3 regions (us-west1, us-east1, eu-west1). Traffic routed to canary instances. Customer-facing error rate steady, but tail latency causing timeouts for some streaming clients.

sam (eng): Reproduced locally: new model variant increases tokenization length by ~10% for certain prompts, causing batch sizes to shrink. Sending snippet of recent deploy tag: `v2-embed-quant`

sam (eng): Quick log extract: ```
[13:20:12] model_loader: loaded model v2-embed-quant (quantized: true)
[13:20:18] serve: batch_size=4 -> batch_wait=200ms, avg_latency=1800ms
[13:22:05] metrics: kv_cache_miss_rate=0.32
```

alex (sre): Thanks. Maria, can you check canary routing and throttle canary traffic to 0%? If we stop canary traffic, we can confirm mitigation.

maria (oncall): Initiating canary traffic hold now — setting route weight canary=0 via trafficcontroller. Command: `tc set-weight canary v2-embed-quant 0`

incident-bot: Action recorded: canary weight set to 0 by maria (oncall).

pd-bot: Update: incident INC12345 status -> acknowledged by maria (oncall).

maria (oncall): Immediate: tail latency back down to baseline in us-west within 30s after hold. Appears to be canary-related.

jon (product): Which customers hit this? Any high-visibility sessions? Need to prepare comms if rollback required.

sam (eng): Telemetry shows several enterprise streaming sessions saw timeouts (10-12 sessions across two customers). No broad user-facing errors.

alex (sre): Proposed next steps: 1) Rollback canary to previous model (v2-embed-fp16) on canary hosts and re-run canary with adjusted tokenization config, OR 2) Keep canary weight 0 and iterate on quant config. Rollback is fastest.

maria (oncall): Agreed. What's the rollback command?

sam (eng): Rollback plan: `deploy rollback embeddings-prod --target canary --image v2-embed-fp16 --no-promote`. I'll start rollback and watch metrics.

alex (sre): Also recommend enabling temporary increased request timeout for streaming clients to reduce client-side errors while we fix. That will be a config flag change in routing layer. Maria, can you scope that?

maria (oncall): I can flip a route-level timeout increase to 12s for streaming for the next 30m. Doing it now.

incident-bot: Action recorded: route timeout updated by maria (oncall) -> streaming_timeout=12s.

sam (eng): Rollback started at 13:28 UTC. Watching logs.

sam (eng): Rollback completed on canary hosts at 13:31 UTC. Verifying: model reverted to v2-embed-fp16.

maria (oncall): Metrics: 90th p50/p95 returned to baseline across regions within 45s of rollback. No new timeouts observed.

alex (sre): Great. PD incident -> resolved? Recommend marking as "mitigated, postmortem required". Sam, open a postmortem and include quantization test matrix.

pd-bot: Incident INC12345 -> resolved by maria (oncall). Resolution: rollback canary to v2-embed-fp16; traffic weight restored to previous state.

maria (oncall): Handing off to ops-night (oncall) for monitoring. ops-night, please watch embedded latency dashboards for next 2 hours and escalate if anything reoccurs.

ops-night (oncall): Acked. Monitoring dashboards and will escalate if spike >3m.

sam (eng): I'll draft postmortem and include: root cause hypothesis (tokenization + quantization interaction), why KV cache miss increased, and test preflight checklist for future model swaps.

jon (product): Thanks everyone. I'll prep a short customer note for the two affected accounts.

maria (oncall): Closing thread for now. Please add any follow-ups to INC12345 timeline. :thumbsup:
